QUOTE: "They are typed against `ServerDataOperatorBase`, so they can call `this.handleRecords` and `this.batchRecords` like the local handlers." and "`BaseDataOperator.batchRecords` ... is the single place a standard handler writes to the database."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says all mixins are typed against ServerDataOperatorBase (extending BaseDataOperator) and that the standard handlers write via the inherited batchRecords. It also notes a few exceptions, but the core conclusion is stated.
